cohort: 258 large for gestational age (LGA) infants born at or after 35 weeks gestation at a tertiary care hospital in South India between December 2018 and May 2020.
finding: Infants born to mothers with GDM had higher rates of neonatal intensive care unit admission, neonatal hyperbilirubinemia, and persistent pulmonary hypertension compared to infants born to mothers without diabetes.
birth_weight: >= large for gestational age (specific birth weight criteria not provided, but median birth weights were 3.92 kg and 3.89kg for infants born to mothers with and without diabetes respectively)
